# The Wintering Well

Official website: https://akrammk5.github.io/The-Wintering-Well-A-Cozy-Guide/
Amazon listing: https://www.amazon.com/Wintering-Well-Mindfulness-Readings-Reflections-ebook/dp/B0FX3MFFSP

## About
The Wintering Well is a gentle English-language guide to slow living, seasonal reflection, rest, simple winter rituals, warm recipes, and journaling prompts.

## Key topics
- winter mindfulness
- slow living
- hygge-inspired seasonal comfort
- journaling and reflection
- rest without guilt
- simple warm recipes
- winter self-care

## Formats
Current Kindle and paperback availability and pricing should be verified on the Amazon listing.
